assessment.integrityNote: This is a graded assessment, so Sentinel confirms it's really you. Everything runs on your device — only an integrity score is kept.
assessment.passedNote: You earned a verified credential — your confidence in this skill just went up.
assessment.retryNote: Review the material and try again — you get a fresh set of questions each time.
assessment.sessionBoundEvidence: Your device's attestation could not be bound to this credential ({reason}). It carries the session's attestation only, so readers will see the result as self-reported.
assessment.roleIntro: Assessing for a sponsor role? Choose it before you start so its requirements apply from the first question.
assessment.roleCameraNote: This role requires the camera for the whole attempt. Turn it on to start; the credential is refused if coverage falls short.
assessment.cameraLost: The camera turned off. This role requires it — turn it back on.
assessment.integritySuspendedNote: No more checks are taken. You can still submit; the result will record that the session was suspended.
assessment.probeIntro: Before grading, a short follow-up on one of your answers. It has a time limit; running out of time or skipping never counts against you.
assessment.probeComplement: Select every option that is not a correct answer.
assessment.generatedProbeConsent: Let this role's model connection write my follow-up questions
assessment.generatedProbeConsentNote: After you submit, the options you chose and the skill description are sent to the model connection the sponsor set up for this role, which writes up to two short follow-up questions. The assessment questions are not sent. If you leave this off, the follow-ups are skipped and that does not count against you.
assessment.requestIntro: {org} asked for this assessment for {role}. Their requirements apply from the first question.
assessment.requestCameraNote: Their requirements need camera checks. Turn on the camera before you start.
assessment.requestAttestationNote: Their requirements need a device that proves it runs a genuine app.

player.noFileAttached: No file attached to this yet.
player.notFoundBody: The course may have been removed or is unavailable.
player.getCredentialTitle: Course complete — get your completion credential.
player.whyMonitoringLabel: Why the integrity check is on
player.whyMonitoringBody: This is a graded assessment, so Sentinel confirms it's you doing the work — that's what makes the credential you earn trustworthy to others.
player.privacyBody: Everything runs on your device. No video, audio, or images are ever recorded, stored, or sent anywhere — only an integrity score. The camera is optional and you can turn it off at any time.
player.noElementBody: Pick a lesson from the list to start learning.
player.feedbackIntro: Tell the instructor what helped and what could be clearer. Your feedback may be used to improve this lesson.
player.feedbackPlaceholder: For example: the worked example moved too quickly.
player.feedbackSaved: Your latest feedback for this lesson was saved.
player.tutorIntro: Ask about this lesson using a model you provide. The tutor is unavailable during assessments.
player.tutorLocalDisclosure: {provider} runs at the local endpoint you configured. Lesson text stays on your device.
player.tutorCloudDisclosure: Lesson text, conversation, and your question are sent to {provider} using your API key.
player.tutorEmpty: Ask for a hint, an example, or help understanding this lesson.
player.tutorQuestionPlaceholder: What would you like help with?
player.tutorKeyPrivacy: Cloud keys stay in this profile's encrypted local database and are never published with the course.
player.reducedConfidenceNoCamera: Camera off — skills earned here will carry lower confidence.

notes.title: Your notes
notes.deleteBody: It is removed from this course on all your devices.
notes.deleteFailed: That note couldn't be deleted. Try again.

label.file: Third-party content from a file you opened on this device.
label.phrase: Alexandria never asks for your recovery phrase inside it.

package.unenrolled: Enrol in this course to take this package. Your progress in it is saved under your enrolment.
package.missing: This package is not on this device yet.
package.loadFailed: The package could not be opened: {error}
package.unsupported: This package uses a standard the player cannot run yet.
package.selfReported: Self-reported by the package; it earns no credential.
package.exitBody: Leave this package for good? Its own rules decide what counts; you cannot resume this attempt afterwards.
package.choose: Choose a lesson from the list to go on.
package.suspended: Your place in this package is saved.
package.ended: You have left this package. Start a fresh attempt to take it again.
package.freshBody: Start this package again from the beginning? Your place in the current attempt is set aside. A completed package stays completed.
package.saveError: Your progress in this package could not be saved. Keep going: it is saved with your next change, and you can resume from the last saved point.

blocked.popup: The package tried to open a pop-up window. It opened inside the player instead.
blocked.dialog: The package tried to show a dialog box, which packages cannot do here.
blocked.plugin: The package needs a browser plug-in, which cannot run here.
blocked.remote: The package tried to load something from {host}. Packages run offline, so it was blocked.
blocked.remoteUnknown: The package tried to load something from the internet. Packages run offline, so it was blocked.

unitWindow.body: This unit is open in its own window.

package.unitExited: This unit has finished. Choose the next one from the list.
package.focusForced: This unit needs the whole screen, so it stays in focus mode until you leave it.
package.courseComplete: Course complete. Package results are self-reported, so this course earns no credential.

packageFile.failed: The package could not be opened: {error}
